description: A solution-aware cloud flow (online only). Leave a property out to keep it. See the guide powertools://guides/cloud-flows.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the flow and its connection references go into.

name.description: The flow's name; an existing cloud flow matches by name.

connectionReferences.description: The connections the definition uses, by the connectionName its actions give in host.connectionName. A missing reference is created.

logicalName.description: Logical name of the connection reference, with the publisher prefix.

displayName.description: For a new reference. Default: the logical name.

state.description: on turns the flow on; it stays off while a connection reference has no connection. Default: a new flow is off, an existing one keeps its state.
